title: Page 238
transc:
S. H. Beckwith  Wh'n Dec 1st 1864 3. PM
Jennie Brown for Billy Tulip Luther has no
other Pekin than the battle lion of Baker
Baden which is now red used to Allen
Smith Summer He asks forth Edwards come ponies
with French Pelton yacht If I repeat as
you direct it will leave not a single
Mount ed man Shylock Quotient talbot Wick Is
this your in ten shun Stanhope Yawl Lamb


R. R. McCaine  Wash'n Dec 1st 1864 1130 AM
Florence Brooks for Negus Have received nothing
from Wardens since my dispatch of Oliver
Franklin ult yacht Arnold Talbot Summer started
yes wherry on a trip by the
upper route & will probably writ urn
wedlock or next libel Geo K Lut
